concerns.text: The plan describes computing Spearman rho and raw p‑value, but the `correlation_result.schema.yaml` contract also requires a `spearman_se` (standard error) field. The plan does not mention calculating or outputting this standard error, creating a mismatch between the plan and the data‑model contract.

The `correlation_result.schema.yaml` expects a single combined record per taxon containing both Spearman metrics (rho, spearman_se, raw_p_value, q_value) and the MaAsLin2 beta coefficient. The plan currently describes producing separate Spearman and MaAsLin2 outputs, which may not satisfy the combined schema. Clarify whether a merged result file will be generated to match the contract.
